note: A/A noise-floor store for backlog item 20 (Gap 18: docs/review-skill-deep-dive-2026-08-17.md:797). Each record in `floors[]` is an EMPIRICAL measurement from running the SAME candidate against itself (the with-skill and without-skill arms both run the identical, current skill) under one exact NoiseFloorKey (scripts/_noise_floor.py: model, grader_prompt_hash, sampling_hash, harness_revision, tool_configuration_hash, scenario_corpus_hash) -- the noise a real lift claim under that same key must clear before it means anything. `noise_ceiling` is the largest |observed_effect| (same computation as _noise_floor.evaluate_lift()'s own effect statistic -- net signed case-level swing as a fraction of the full corpus) recorded across the A/A replicate runs backing that record: how big an apparent 'lift' pure noise alone produced when both arms ran the identical candidate.
measurement_status: This item (backlog 20) ships the storage format, the key, and the significance machinery ONLY -- per its own scope, it does NOT run the A/A arm (that is a separate, batched, LLM-spend sweep). `floors` is therefore EMPTY: there is no measured record here, real or placeholder. scripts/_noise_floor.evaluate_lift() reads this file (or an equivalent in-memory list) via `lookup_floor()`, and an empty list means every lookup returns None -- every lift claim is `unreportable` until a real A/A sweep populates a record for its exact key (D6: absence must never be read as floor=0, and this file's emptiness is itself the proof that nothing here has been fabricated).
